summary: Performance optimization validation complete. MutationObserver removal verified, all pages render correctly with no console errors. Fonts (Chivo, Inter, JetBrains Mono) loading via media=print trick working. All 3 user roles tested across all accessible pages.
passed_tests: Login page loads with background image and form
Fonts render correctly - Chivo for headings, Inter for body, JetBrains Mono for code
Trader login works (trader@fxtracker.com / Trader@123)
Dashboard loads with charts (Bar, Pie) and metrics
Dashboard date range switching (7d, 30d, YTD, All Time) works
Navigation Dashboard -> My Deals works
Navigation My Deals -> New Deal works
New Deal form loads with populated dropdowns (transaction types, transfer types, currencies, companies, banks)
Treasury login works (treasury@fxtracker.com / Treasury@123)
Treasury Dashboard shows 'Operations overview' subtitle
Treasury Deal Queue page loads with tabs (Pending, Processed)
Admin login works (admin@fxtracker.com / Admin@123)
Admin Dashboard shows 'System overview' subtitle
Admin Dashboard shows Total Users metric (3)
Admin Reference Data page loads with 6 tabs (Companies, Banks, Transaction Types, Transfer Types, Currencies)
Admin Users page loads with user table
Admin Audit Trail page loads with log entries
Admin Transactions page loads with transaction history
No console errors on login page
No console errors on trader pages (Dashboard, My Deals, New Deal)
No console errors on treasury pages (Dashboard, Deal Queue)
No console errors on admin pages (Dashboard, Reference Data, Users, Audit Trail, Transactions)
MutationObserver removal verified - no MutationObserver in codebase
No duplicate @import for Google Fonts in CSS
debug-wrapper CSS minimized to single rule
critical_code_review_comments: MutationObserver successfully removed from index.html - no longer watching document.body for DOM changes
Google Fonts loaded via media=print onload=this.media='all' pattern for non-blocking load
Font weights reduced to 400,700 for Chivo and 400,500,600 for Inter
CSS @import for Google Fonts removed from index.css (was loaded twice)
debug-wrapper CSS reduced from 28 inherit rules to single display:contents rule
App.js prefetchAllPages uses staggered 150ms delay between chunk loads instead of all-at-once
Login page image optimized with q=60, w=800, decoding=async, fetchPriority=low
DashboardPage charts have isAnimationActive=false for reduced CPU usage
context_for_next_testing_agent: Performance optimizations validated: MutationObserver removed, Google Fonts non-blocking, CSS debug-wrapper minimized, prefetch staggered. All 3 roles tested with full page navigation. No browser hangs or performance issues observed during testing.
